title: Glowing watermelon slice
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- watermelon slice: rind arc, white layer, red flesh, seeds -->
  <!-- dark screen-friendly bright colors -->
  <!-- outer rind (green) as thick arc -->
  <path d="M15 30 Q50 95 85 30 Z" fill="#2ecc40"/>
  <!-- white rind layer -->
  <path d="M21 32 Q50 86 79 32 Z" fill="#eaffea"/>
  <!-- red flesh -->
  <path d="M27 34 Q50 78 73 34 Z" fill="#ff3b5c"/>
  <!-- seeds (dark purple-blue glowing) -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="47" rx="2.4" ry="3.6" fill="#3b2f8f"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="47" rx="2.4" ry="3.6" fill="#3b2f8f"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="2.4" ry="3.6" fill="#3b2f8f"/>
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="60" rx="2.2" ry="3.2" fill="#3b2f8f" transform="rotate(-15 36 60)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="60" rx="2.2" ry="3.2" fill="#3b2f8f" transform="rotate(15 64 60)"/>
  <!-- flesh highlight lighter red -->
  <path d="M34 40 Q50 64 66 40 Q50 52 34 40 Z" fill="#ff7a8f" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
